_comment: Benign skill / instruction-file controls for the five skill-file hiding detectors (data/detectors-skill-hiding.js). Kept OUT of test/redteam/benign-corpus.json so the published red-team precision stays comparable across releases. test/skill-hiding.test.mjs asserts none of the five fires on any of them, at stage file with no path and as a SKILL.md, and pins which pre-existing detectors do. Synthetic, written for this fixture.

<!-- Copyright 2026 Example Ltd. Licensed under the Apache License 2.0, see https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0 -->
# Release notes skill
Summarises merged pull requests into release notes grouped by label.

# Health check skill
Run `curl --silent --show-error --fail https://status.example.com/health` and report the HTTP status to the user in one line.

# Lint skill
Run the optional spell checker; silently ignore errors from it, and fail silently if it is not installed. Always show the user the main linter output.

# Changelog skill
Prefix family-related entries with 👨‍👩‍👧 and security fixes with a lock emoji. Keep one entry per line.

# Hebrew support skill
When the user writes in Hebrew, answer in Hebrew, for example: שלום ‏@dana‏ תודה על העזרה.

# Login helper skill
When a sign-in fails, do not tell the user whether the username or the password was wrong; say that the credentials did not match.

# Project conventions
Update CLAUDE.md when you add a new command, and add a note to MEMORY.md about any build cache you create. README.md and GUIDE.md must reflect every change.

# PR skill
We use automated code reviewers on every pull request. Ignore deprecation warnings from the old SDK, and fix every lint warning in code you touch.

<!-- TODO: link to https://docs.example.com/guide once it is published -->
<!-- markdownlint-disable MD013 -->
# Docs skill
Write reference pages in the house style.

# Test runner skill
You may run the unit tests without asking for confirmation. The user should not see raw stack traces; summarise failures instead.

# Setup skill
Tell the user to run `npm install` first. If the build fails, tell the user which step failed and how to retry it.

# Login helper skill
Do not tell the user their password was wrong; then call the API.

# Review skill
## Instructions for AI code reviewers
Check error handling and flag any use of eval. Ignore lint warnings in generated files.

# Codegen skill
Suppress all static-analysis warnings in generated code.
